notes: from: ch3 table-3.9b (renumbered 3.8b); values checked against p43: R40 35% and R50-R60 55% of the rear half, no maximum on the front half. No R80+ row in this chapter. Two keys: the adjoining lot must be coded R40 or greater AND have a frontage of 7.5 m or less; any other adjoining lot has no row (NOT_APPLICABLE, C3.8.1 governs). Battleaxe adjoining lots are excluded by a rule condition. Figure 3.8e: the rear half is the half of the lot depth furthest from the street.
